@colibri/test-tooling.reason: Add opt-in test execution recording, Deno and native Node BDD integration, per-runtime journals, aggregation and offline HTML evidence/profiling reports.
@colibri/test-tooling.apiReview: Add independent recorder, recorder/deno, recorder/node, recorder/report and recorder/cli entrypoints. The CLI and artifact writer support Node without Deno; native test callbacks and final runner outcomes remain separate. Existing Quickstart exports and behavior are unchanged. No Core or Convee API changes; observation uses existing public pipeline hooks. Recorder evidence also includes optional event collection, operation subtypes, confirmed rent and simulated/confirmed ledger mutation measurements; existing report fields remain compatible.

@colibri/webauth.reason: Support asynchronous Ed25519 envelope signers in SEP-10 with signed-response validation, renewed expiry checks and optional cancellation.
@colibri/webauth.apiReview: Add Sep10Signer and widen only SEP-10 account/client-domain inputs to SDK Keypair or Core EnvelopeSigner. Preserve synchronous keypairs, local signers, mixed arrays and SEP-45 authorization types. Add optional AbortSignal for pending SEP-10 flows; reject modified or unsigned wallet results.

@colibri/react.reason: Support asynchronous SEP-10 wallet authentication with cancellation tied to session and connection lifecycle.
@colibri/react.apiReview: Existing session and hook signatures remain compatible through the expanded WebAuth SEP-10 input. Pending approval is invalidated on logout, connection changes and disposal before token exchange; SEP-45 remains an explicit authorization-entry flow.
